name: Berserker Axe
description: A heavy-bladed battleaxe whose haft is wrapped in hide stained dark.
body:
## What it does

Any axe can carry this curse; this one is a battleaxe. It strikes truer and harder than a plain axe, and while you are attuned to it your body grows tougher with every level you have earned.

## Curse

Once attuned, you will not part with it, and you fight at disadvantage with any other weapon. Whenever a hostile creature harms you, make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or go berserk, attacking the nearest creature each turn until none is left within 60 feet that you can see or hear.

features.name: Fury
features.text: While attuned, your hit point maximum rises by 1 for each level you have.

features.name: Curse
features.text: You will not part with it, you have disadvantage with other weapons, and when a hostile creature damages you a failed DC 15 Wisdom save sends you berserk.
